mapper.sql: select id, track_id, machine_id, face_id, confidence, recognition_time, departure_time, detection_img from face_recognition_events
mapper.insert:
insert into face_recognition_events
id, track_id, machine_id, face_id, confidence, recognition_time, departure_time, detection_img,
#{id}, #{trackId}, #{machineId}, #{faceId}, #{confidence}, #{recognitionTime}, #{departureTime}, #{detectionImg},
mapper.delete:
delete from face_recognition_events where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.track_id, e.machine_id, e.face_id, e.confidence, e.recognition_time, e.departure_time, e.detection_img, m.machine_name as deviceName, f.user_name as faceName FROM face_recognition_events e LEFT JOIN ba_machine m ON e.machine_id = m.machine_id LEFT JOIN face_database f ON e.face_id = f.face_id WHERE e.recognition_time >= CURDATE() ORDER BY e.recognition_time DESC

SELECT hours.hour, IFNULL(COUNT(e.id), 0) as count FROM ( SELECT n as hour_num, CONCAT(LPAD(n, 2, '0'), ':00') as hour FROM ( SELECT @row := @row + 1 as n FROM information_schema.tables, (SELECT @row := -1) r LIMIT 24 ) hours_gen WHERE n <= HOUR(NOW()) ) hours LEFT JOIN face_recognition_events e ON DATE(e.recognition_time) = CURDATE() AND HOUR(e.recognition_time) = hours.hour_num GROUP BY hours.hour, hours.hour_num ORDER BY hours.hour_num

SELECT e.id AS eventId, e.identity_type AS identityType, e.face_id AS faceId, CASE WHEN e.identity_type = 'PERSON' THEN p.user_name WHEN e.identity_type = 'STRANGER' THEN s.display_name ELSE '未知' END AS displayName, e.machine_id AS machineId, m.machine_name AS deviceName, e.recognition_time AS recognitionTime, e.departure_time AS departureTime, e.confidence AS confidence, e.detection_img AS detectionImg FROM face_recognition_events_v1 e LEFT JOIN ba_machine m ON e.machine_id = m.machine_id LEFT JOIN face_person p ON e.identity_type = 'PERSON' AND e.face_id = p.id LEFT JOIN face_stranger s ON e.identity_type = 'STRANGER' AND e.face_id = s.id
ORDER BY e.recognition_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT -- 事件信息 e.id AS eventId, e.machine_id AS machineId, m.machine_name AS deviceName, e.recognition_time AS recognitionTime, e.departure_time AS departureTime, e.confidence AS confidence, e.detection_img AS detectionImg, e.identity_type AS identityType, e.face_id AS faceId,
-- 正式人员信息（PERSON 时才有值） p.user_name AS personName, p.person_type AS personType, p.job_no AS jobNo, p.dept_name AS deptName, p.phone AS phone, p.id_card AS idCard, p.face_image AS personFaceImg, p.gender AS personGender, p.age AS personAge, p.status AS personStatus,
-- 陌生人信息（STRANGER 时才有值） s.display_name AS strangerDisplayName, s.face_image AS strangerFaceImg, s.gender AS strangerGender, s.age AS strangerAge, s.status AS strangerStatus, s.remark AS strangerRemark FROM face_recognition_events_v1 e LEFT JOIN ba_machine m ON e.machine_id = m.machine_id LEFT JOIN face_person p ON e.identity_type = 'PERSON' AND e.face_id = p.id LEFT JOIN face_stranger s ON e.identity_type = 'STRANGER' AND e.face_id = s.id WHERE e.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
